<!--
Measured, not read: a dissertation is double spaced at 24pt, as a
manuscript is, in .pdf and typst alike, from one line of a paragraph to the
next and from one paragraph to the next. A block quotation and a reference
entry are single spaced, and a reference list stands a double space between
one entry and the next.

typst set the body's lines 26pt apart: dissertation mode kept the 18pt
leading the manuscript gave up when it moved to 24pt, and took the
manuscript's 16pt paragraph spacing with it, so its paragraphs stood 24pt
apart while the lines inside them stood 26pt.

Each line measured begins with a word made up for it, and a line is ended by
hand (a backslash) where two lines of one paragraph are wanted.
-->

# Spacing

Lineone of a paragraph whose line is ended by hand.\
Linetwo of the same paragraph.

Paraone is a paragraph of its own.

Paratwo follows it.

> Quoteone of a quotation whose line is ended by hand.\
> Quotetwo of the same quotation.

Afterquote is the body again.
